title: Ruby preset manifest
description: manifest.json inside a .rbyset or .rbypck. Both extensions are the same zip container with a different `kind`, so this is one schema and one parser, forever.

format.description: Fixed. Lets a file be identified without trusting its extension.

format_version.description: The container's own version, separate from any effect's schema version.

kind.description: `set` is one fragment (.rbyset). `pack` is many fragments plus a shared assets/ folder (.rbypck). 200 transitions sharing 12 textures ship 12 textures.

id.description: Immortal, dotted, lower_snake segments. `core.*` is reserved for first-party content; third parties use `com.vendor.*`. Same rule as an effect id (D1).

author.description: A preset library is a body of authored work with people's names on it. Sapphire's 3,836 presets credit twelve named authors; this field is why.

tags.description: Flat and mixed-axis on purpose: technique, mood, colour, subject. Sapphire shipped a structured tags object with named axes AND a flat list side by side, and the flat list is the one that survived.

drop_target.description: Where this fragment is meant to land. A shake goes onto a layer, a transition onto a cut, a full title build onto the timeline. Declared rather than guessed, because guessing wrong silently produces a mess the user has to undo.

effects.description: Effect id to the schema version this content was authored against.

requires.description: A version check, not a dependency check. Every effect ships with the app, so the only possible failure is a preset newer than the install.

variants.description: Absent means one variant at content.json.

controls.description: The handful of knobs the author chose to surface. Everything else stays editable underneath; this is what shows first, not what is allowed.

target.description: JSON pointer into content.json naming the value this drives.

sets.description: Only on kind=pack: paths to the member manifests.

preview.description: Plays on hover in the browser.

text.description: Path to LICENSE inside the container.

signature.description: Reserved and unused. Retrofitting a signature slot into a format already in the wild is miserable, so it exists from the first file ever written.

range.description: Same shape as an effect parameter's range. A hard limit and a slider are different things; see core::ParamRange.
